attack_chains.title: [api] Credential Disclosure to Unauthorized State Mutation

stages.description: Raw HTTP client error object passed directly to logger

attack_chains.narrative: In component 'api', an attacker harvesting leaked authorization tokens or credentials via DATA-001 can execute state-changing actions via unguarded mutating endpoint AUTHZ-001 without triggering access control defenses.
attack_chains.remediation: Redact sensitive log outputs and enforce controller/route guard decorators.

findings.title: Unauthenticated mutating route in Express (POST /bulk-load)
findings.impact: Route handler processes mutating requests without prior authentication middleware, permitting unauthorized data modification.
findings.recommendation: Insert authentication and authorization middleware (e.g. `passport.authenticate` or `verifyToken`) before the route handler.

findings.title: Unauthenticated mutating route in Express (DELETE /:repo_name)
findings.impact: Route handler processes mutating requests without prior authentication middleware, permitting unauthorized data modification.
findings.recommendation: Insert authentication and authorization middleware (e.g. `passport.authenticate` or `verifyToken`) before the route handler.

findings.title: Raw HTTP client error object passed directly to logger
findings.impact: Serializing raw HTTP client error objects directly to logs exposes full request configurations, which frequently contain Authorization headers and Bearer tokens.
findings.recommendation: Log only `error.message` or `error.code` rather than serializing the entire HTTP error object.
owasp: A09 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
